title: UI风格#46 - Moroccan Mosaic (摩洛哥马赛克)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Mosaic style When color palette Then features terracotta, cobalt blue, saffron gold, sand, emerald

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Mosaic style When layout Then geometric tiles, zellige patterns, arch doorways

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Moroccan Mosaic style When UI elements Then mosaic borders, geometric patterns, lantern glow
